text:
olivia: quick FYI — I'm rolling a small routing+batching tweak for tenant 'fastlane' to address late-afternoon p95 spikes. canary 2% for 30m.
deploy-bot: config deploy queued by olivia — id cfg_4782 — canary=2% window=30m. will auto-rollback on error-rate>5% sustained for 5m.
raj: :thumbsup: what's changing precisely?
olivia: not changing model or quant. tweaking batching.window_ms 30->20 and inflight_limit 8->12 for routing-group fastlane-only. also nudging tenant rate_limit +10% to absorb small bursts.
anya: please add smoke checks and the datadog p95 dashboard alert. I'll watch traces.
olivia: done — added a smoke job (/ops/smoke fastlane) and a short-lived Datadog monitor 'fastlane.p95 > baseline*1.15' set for 5m. pinned model-version v3.2.1 on that routing-group to avoid variant swapping.
sre-jen: running preflight: curl -sS -X POST https://internal.api/health -d '{"tenant":"fastlane"}' -> OK. no kvcache pressure in metrics.
deploy-bot: canary started (cfg_4782) — 2% traffic routed to fastlane-canary.
sre-jen: first 10m looks clean, error-rate 0.1% and latency down ~18% p95. no increase in cpu/gpu churn.
raj: nice. what's the rollback plan if kvcache or tail latency regresses?
olivia: manual rollback steps in runbook: 1) stop canary (/ops/deploy cancel cfg_4782) 2) revert batching.window_ms to 30 and inflight_limit to 8 3) restore previous rate_limit. I've left the config under cfg_4782 so revert is a single command.
deploy-bot: canary progressed to 20% after green checks (cfg_4782) — running 15m ramp.
anya: I'm watching traces and sampling slow requests now. will flag if any weird token-level stalls :eyes:.
sre-jen: no anomalies so far in span traces or redis metrics.
olivia: thanks — I'll keep observing for the next 30m. marking status: observing. ping me to escalate or roll back. :thumbsup:
